comparison.cache: every run starts a fresh gateway/model process; existing disk cache, downloads disabled
comparison.order: all baseline repetitions, then all current INFO repetitions; optional current CRITICAL last
comparison.interpretation: workflow wall time includes loading, upload, recognition, edit alignment, export and cleanup; baseline text is not accuracy ground truth
comparison.logging_interpretation: small-sample exploratory comparison; it cannot establish a stable logging overhead below 3 percent

runs.model_state: fresh model and gateway process; disk inputs explicitly warmed

cache_warm.scope: existing fixed-revision weights/tokenizer plus audio; no download

runs.job_timing_interpretation: created is after upload/hash; started is _run_job entry. With prefetch on, normalization precedes started, so processing-after-started and pipeline total exclude prefetched decoding. Batch wall and end-to-end include it; overlapping stages must not be summed.
runs.inference_interval_source: actual parent-worker transcription RPC envelope elapsed time
runs.interval_interpretation: UTC completion timestamp minus monotonic RPC duration; contains IPC and scheduling, not CUDA kernel timing
